title: AuditFindingPayload
description: Payload for the AUDIT_FINDING intent. Audit Agent reports a quality issue, policy violation, or inconsistency.

classification.description: Finding category — must match Audit Agent prompt taxonomy.

severity.description: CRITICAL halts active operations until resolved.

target_id.description: Identifier of the audited artifact (transaction_id, campaign_id, message_id, run_id, etc.).

issue.description: What's wrong, in plain language. Specific enough that the originating agent can act.

recommended_correction.description: What the originating agent should do to fix it.

detected_by.description: Almost always agent_audit; other agents may also flag findings.

policy_ref.description: Path or reference to the policy that was violated (e.g. 'policies/rbac_policy.json#approval_thresholds').

schema_ref.description: If classification is SCHEMA_VIOLATION, the schema that wasn't satisfied.

evidence.description: Supporting data (event ids, related findings, sample message excerpts).

related_findings.description: Other finding_ids in a connected pattern (used for PATTERN_ANOMALY).

examples.issue: Campaign copy claims 'GDPR compliant' but no DPA reference is attached and no Privacy Agent review is recorded for this campaign.
examples.recommended_correction: Either remove the GDPR claim or request PRIVACY_REVIEW_REQUEST and attach DPA reference before publication.
